book.name: Tutui Masososaꞌ
book.title: Tutui Masososaꞌ Mulai neme Manetualain adu lalai no dae-bafoꞌ a

content: Isak naloo na tutiꞌ Yakob, boe ma ana feen ua-naleꞌ ma lelea-nonoreꞌ nae, “Nenene matalolole! O bosoꞌ sao ana feto Kanaꞌan.
Tehuu o leo Padan Aram mu, nai baꞌi Betuel uman. O muu sao ma toꞌo mi Laban ana feton esa.
Ela leoꞌ bea na Manetualain fo Manakuasa Nan Seli, riꞌ fee o ua-naleꞌ, ela o upu-ana mara tamba dodouꞌ, ma dadi reuꞌ lahenda nusa kahereꞌ.
Ela leoꞌ bea na Manetualain hehehelu-barataan neuꞌ Abraham a tuda leo o neu, ma o tititi-nonosim. Ela leoꞌ bea na o soa dae ia, fo riꞌ Manetualain helu basa feen neuꞌ Abraham so.”
Isak dedea basa nae leoꞌ na, boe ma ana nadenu Yakob leo Padan Aram neu, nai toꞌon Laban no baꞌin Betuel uman.
Esau sao Ismael ana feto na
Esau namanene nae, Isak fee basa ua-naleꞌ neuꞌ Yakob so, ma horo ni fo bosoꞌ sao ana feto Kanaꞌan. Ana namanene boe, nae papa na nadenu fadi na so, fo neu sao toꞌo na ana feton esa nai Padan Aram.
Basa de Yakob namanene neuꞌ papa na no mama na paretan, boe ma ana leo Padan Aram neu.
Esau boe bubuluꞌ nae, papa na ta nahiiꞌ ria sao na, lahenda Kanaꞌan ara.
De, ana leo papa bauinan Ismael neu, de sao na seluꞌ Ismael ana feton, nade Mahalat. Mahalat nana, Nebayot fadi na.
Yakob nalamei nai Betel
Basa boe ma, Yakob laꞌo ela Beer Syeba, fo sakaꞌ leo Haran neu.
Ledo a tena, boe ma ana losa mamanaꞌ esa, de suku neuꞌ na. Ana sakaꞌ suku, boe ma hai na batu esa de ainulu neuꞌ lain.
Hatun ria nalamei. Ana nita edaaeꞌ esa, nanaseleꞌ nai dae a, ma peda na losa lalai. Basa de Manetualain eilaꞌo-limalopen reme nusatetu-ikutemaꞌ a mai, ara onda-ae resiꞌ edaaeꞌ ria.

Nai meis ria daleꞌ, Yakob nita MANETUALAIN napadei nai boboa na, basa de dedea nae, “Au ia MANETUALAIN, o baꞌim Abraham, ma o papam Isak Manetualain a. Neuꞌ ko Au fee dae ia neuꞌ o, ma tititi-nonosi mara.
Neuꞌ ko o tititi-nonosim dedesi na sama leoꞌ afu-dae. Ma neuꞌ ko ara kofela nai basa mamanaꞌ ara. Neme o tititi-nonosim mai, neuꞌ ko basa lahenda nusaꞌ nai dae-bafoꞌ a hapu ua-naleꞌ.

Mafarerene matalolole! O leo beaꞌ mu oo, Au sama-sama ma anea o. Neuꞌ ko Au o faliꞌ o leo nusaꞌ ia mai. Au ta foa ela o mesaꞌko fa. Ma neuꞌ ko Au tao atetu basa Au hehelu-barataaꞌ fo Au feen neuꞌ o a.”
Fai fo Yakob foa na aon, boe ma ana nae, “Au besaꞌ ko bubuluꞌ ae MANETUALAIN nai ia boe!”
Ma ana bii, boe ma afi nae, “Ae! Mamanaꞌ ia tao na au ao ka maninis a. Tantu Manetualain uma Na nai ia. Ma ia nana, nusatetu-ikutemaꞌ a lelesu na.”
Balahaaꞌ, balahaa ana na, boe ma Yakob foa de hai na tutiꞌ batu fo riꞌ ainulu neuꞌ lai ni a, de napadedeiꞌ nan dadi neuꞌ tanda. Basa de ana poꞌa mina neuꞌ batu ria, fo doꞌo-tabe neuꞌ Manetualain.
Ana hule mamanaꞌ ria nade, Betel, fo sosoa na, ‘Manetualain uma na’. (Maulu na mamanaꞌ ria, nade Lus).
Basa ria, boe ma Yakob soo-supa nae, “Kalu Manetualain sama-sama, ma nanea nai au lalaꞌo ki ia, ma nahao-nafati au,
losaꞌ au fali no *soda-moleꞌ, neuꞌ ko MANETUALAIN dadi neuꞌ au Ramatua ka.
Batu fo au apadedeiꞌ ana ia, dadi mamana dodoꞌo-tatabeꞌ neuꞌ Manetualain. Ma basa-basan fo Manetualain bati fee au, neuꞌ ko au fee faliꞌ babatiꞌ esa neme babatiꞌ sanahulu mai.”

footnotes.text: Padan Aram nana, riꞌ Mesopotamia, nai nusa Siria pooꞌ ii naneneaꞌ no Irak. Haran nana riꞌ, kota nai Padan Aram.
